description: Ouvrages hydrauliques du bassin Loire Bretagne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by metadata.carmencarto.fr. Location of hydraulic structures (dams and flood shavings) in the Loire Bretagne basin. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hydraulic works in the Loire Bretagne basin" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
